import csv, hashlib, io, json
from pathlib import Path

base = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue')
draft = base / 'operator-draft.md'
expected_digest = '4354db998e4f0001ed5c33b9345f7ebc8ef3d8b42fa3b1227eebb9ac290b0c6b'
actual_digest = hashlib.sha256(draft.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert actual_digest == expected_digest, 'Existing operator draft does not match the recorded decision hash'

source = 'SKU,Barcode\nSH-100-BLK,0012345\nSH-100-BLU,0054321\n'
clean = 'SKU,Barcode\nSH-100-BLU,0054321\nSH-100-BLK,0012345\n'
swapped = 'SKU,Barcode\nSH-100-BLU,0012345\nSH-100-BLK,0054321\n'
ambiguous = 'SKU,Barcode\nSH-100-BLU,0054321\nSH-100-BLU,0012345\n'

def read_by_sku(text):
    indexed = {}
    for row in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text)):
        sku = row['SKU']
        if not sku or sku in indexed:
            raise ValueError('Blank or repeated SKU prevents a reliable row comparison')
        indexed[sku] = row['Barcode']
    return indexed

def compare(before, after):
    original, candidate = read_by_sku(before), read_by_sku(after)
    if original.keys() != candidate.keys():
        raise ValueError('SKU sets differ')
    return [{'sku': sku, 'field': 'Barcode', 'before': original[sku], 'after': candidate[sku]} for sku in sorted(original) if original[sku] != candidate[sku]]

clean_findings = compare(source, clean)
swapped_findings = compare(source, swapped)
assert clean_findings == []
assert swapped_findings == [{'sku': 'SH-100-BLK', 'field': 'Barcode', 'before': '0012345', 'after': '0054321'}, {'sku': 'SH-100-BLU', 'field': 'Barcode', 'before': '0054321', 'after': '0012345'}]
try:
    compare(source, ambiguous)
except ValueError as error:
    rejection = str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('Duplicate SKU was accepted')

result = {'draft_sha256': actual_digest, 'scope': 'Separate offline row comparison on fictional text. Requires matching unique SKUs and both before/after tables. Existing verifier and draft are unchanged.', 'fixtures': {'source': source, 'reordered_match': clean, 'swapped_barcodes': swapped, 'duplicate_sku': ambiguous}, 'results': {'reordered_match': clean_findings, 'swapped_barcodes': swapped_findings, 'duplicate_sku': rejection}, 'buyer_result_en': 'Two barcode values changed across two SKUs. See the before and after text for each SKU.', 'buyer_result_fr': 'Deux valeurs de code-barres ont changé pour deux UGS. Consultez les valeurs avant et après pour chaque UGS.', 'limits': 'Synthetic rehearsal only. No live import, recipient delivery, paid order or settlement was tested.'}
output = base / 'delivery-rehearsal' / 'director-manual-comparison-control.json'
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
